title: It's not just learning. It's transformation.
subtitle: Word of Faith Bible Institute (WOFBI)
quotes: What you don't know, you don't know, and what you won't learn, you won't know. What you don't know, you will pay for it. — Dr. David Oyedepo
There is no mountain anywhere; every man's ignorance is his mountain. — Dr. David Oyedepo
description: The Word of Faith Bible Institute (WOFBI) is a Ministry and Leadership Training Centre, which serves as the training arm of the Living Faith Church Worldwide. The Institute runs periodical three-week specialized courses designed to motivate participants positively towards distinction in their secular and spiritual engagements.
vision: The Vision of the Institute is in line with the mandate given to Dr. David Oyedepo in May 1983: I will through THIS MINISTRY RAISE THE FOUNDATION OF MANY OTHER MINISTRIES.
